patch_description: This crossover retains the strongest-performing shared structure: independent RY and pre-entanglement RZ rotations followed by the full allowed CZ connectivity graph. It removes the repeated post-entanglement RZ layer, which increased depth and gate count without improving parameter count and reduced the observed score. The resulting ansatz matches the best prior configuration, using 108 parameters rather than 162 and fewer gates than either post-rotation variant.
